description: This Java class 'CustomShippingQuotesRegion' models a shipping region with custom attributes including region name, associated countries, and quote items, and implements JSON serialization.

classes.name: CustomShippingQuotesRegion
classes.description: A model class representing a custom shipping region with name, associated countries, and quote items, capable of converting itself to a JSON string.

methods.name: setQuoteItems
methods.description: Sets the list of quote items for the shipping region.

methods.name: getQuoteItems
methods.description: Returns the list of quote items.

methods.name: setCountries
methods.description: Sets the list of country codes for the region.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Returns the list of country codes.

methods.name: setCustomRegionName
methods.description: Sets the custom name for the region.

methods.name: getCustomRegionName
methods.description: Returns the custom name of the region.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Converts the object to a JSON string representation including region name, countries, and quote items.
